variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE finished standalone symbol-only logo concept for a stylized 3D tactical shooter game set in desert frontier outposts, matching an elegant dark navy and warm sand-gold HUD. Square image, perfectly flat solid deep midnight navy #10232d background. One centered, clean, professionally constructed geometric emblem in warm matte sand-gold #f8c976. Generous negative space, emblem occupies about 55% of square. Crisp vector-like silhouette, bold enough to read at 32px, restrained premium tactical game identity, balanced proportions, no tiny ornament. Absolutely NO letter A, NO letters, NO text, NO wordmark, NO numbers, NO watermark. No mockup, no scene, no gradients, no metallic 3D, no glow, no shadows, no distressed texture. The subject is a gun aiming sight / crosshair, not a picture of a gun. Design direction 1: a distinctive circular aiming sight. Four broad clean interrupted arcs form an open circular reticle, with short precise inward-pointing cardinal sight bars and a small diamond central target. Pure standalone reticle, no enclosing badge. Strong iconic symmetrical geometry, precision and focus.
